newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish PPI seen rising 0.3 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish PPI seen rising 0.3 pct in May.

text.p: Sweden's producer prices were expected to rise by 0.3 percent in May for a year-on-year rise of 1.1 percent, a Reuters poll of 12 analysts found on Thursday.
Forecasts for the month-on-month figure varied between 0.1 percent and 0.5 percent.
In April producer prices rise by 0.7 percent which gave a rise of 0.2 percent for the previous 12 month period.
In May 1996 Sweden's PPI rose 0.6 percent for a yuear-on-year fall of 2.9 percent.
Analysts questioned for the survey were from Carnegie, Consensus, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Nomura, Nordbanken, Penser, S-E-Banken, Swedbank, Transferator and Ohman.
Statistics Sweden will publish the PPI for May on June 26 and 0800 GMT.
